description: This file defines React functional components that render various SVG icons used in the HTML reporter of Playwright, including icons for search, arrows, warnings, attachments, and other UI elements.

methods.name: spacer
methods.description: Returns a span element styled as an icon spacer.

methods.description: Returns an SVG element representing a search icon.
